entries.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft. Sitting back on an incline bench with the back and head on the pad; the upper arms hang straight down and do not move while the forearms curl the dumbbells to shoulder height, pause, and lower more slowly to straight arms. The palms-forward grip is shown by the bells reading end-on. Not drawn: the bench angle is not given by the source, so 60 degrees is a drawing choice.
entries.summary: Sitting back on an incline bench, curl the dumbbells to shoulder height with the upper arms hanging still, pause, then lower slowly to straight arms.

frames.caption: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down and palms facing forward.
Keeping the upper arms still, curl the dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.
Back stays on the bench. Lower to a full stretch.

entries.name: Incline Hammer Curls
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft. Sitting back on an incline bench; the upper arms hang straight down and stay still while the elbows bend, with the palms facing each other for the whole rep, so each dumbbell is seen along its length and stays square to the forearm. A pause at the top, then a slower lowering to straight arms. Not drawn: the bench angle is not given by the source, so 60 degrees is a drawing choice.
entries.summary: Sitting back on an incline bench with palms facing in, curl the dumbbells up with the upper arms hanging still, pause, then lower slowly to straight arms.

frames.caption: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down and palms facing each other.
Keeping the upper arms still and the palms facing in, bend the elbows to curl the dumbbells up.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.
Palms face each other throughout. Upper arms hang still.

entries.name: Lying Cable Curl
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft, with a close-up of the near hand showing the underhand grip: lying on the back facing a low pulley with straight legs and the feet braced against the machine base, holding the cable bar in a shoulder-width underhand grip with the upper arms still and close to the torso while curling the bar toward the chest, squeezing, and lowering slowly.
entries.summary: Lying on your back with straight legs and feet braced against a low-pulley machine base, curl the bar with a shoulder-width underhand grip toward the chest while keeping the upper arms still beside the body, squeeze, then lower slowly.

frames.caption: Lie on your back facing a low pulley with the feet braced against the base of the machine and the legs straight, holding the bar with a shoulder-width underhand grip.
Keeping the upper arms still and the elbows close to the body, curl the bar toward the chest.
Squeeze at the chest with the elbows close to the body.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.
Elbows stay close to the body and upper arms stay still.
